statement: The NDC reports Uzbekistan’s average temperature rose about 0.29°C per decade from the early 1950s, roughly twice the global rate.

compact_statement: For 2039 with 90% water availability, the NDC projects 10–13% cotton and winter-wheat yield losses and 10–12% for alfalfa under RCP4.5/8.5.
